creatures.name: Psi Crystal
creatures.description:
You can expend 2 psi points to cast find familiar, but your familiar uses the Psi Crystal statistics and requires a crystal worth 10 gp instead of the spell’s normal material components. The Psi Crystal has your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You can use psionic disciplines with a range greater than Self through it as if standing in its location. If it is destroyed, you gain its memories as your own. While it is active, you can deactivate it as a bonus action to regain 2 expended psi points.

abilities.description:
Enhancement is the ability to interact with a creature’s nature and abilities with your psionic power.

Enhancing Skill. Whenever you make an ability check using Strength or Dexterity, you can add 1d4 to the result.

Alternate Effects. When you learn this discipline, you can use your Psionics feature to cast the following spells. If a spell can be cast at a higher level, you can spend additional psi points to cast it at a level equal to the psi points spent.

You empower the body of a target creature you can see with your psionics. The target gains 1d6 temporary hit points, and the next time it deals damage, it deals 1d6 additional damage to one target of that damage roll. Any remaining temporary hit points from this power fade when you use it again.

  • Resilient (3 psi points): The target gains resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
  • Savage (1+ psi points): The target’s next weapon attack deals 1d6 additional damage for each point spent.
  • Swift (2 psi points): The target gains an additional action usable only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

abilities.name: Projection Discipline
abilities.description:
Projection is the ability to project what is in your mind to the outside world with your psionic power.

Project Item. As an action, you can project an inanimate object you imagine into your hands. It can’t be larger than 3 feet on any side or weigh more than 10 pounds, and is clearly ethereal in nature. The item behaves as a solid object. Weapons created with this feature deal force damage. Projected items fade after 1 minute, and you can have no more than three projected items at a time.

modifier_catalog.name: Astral Construct
modifier_catalog.summary: 1 action · 60 feet · Concentration, up to 1 minute · 7 psi augments
modifier_catalog.description:
You project an ethereal creation from your mind at a space you can see within range, taking the shape of a Medium or smaller creature, weapon, or other object. It is clearly ethereal. When you create it, and on subsequent turns when you use your action to mentally control it, you can move it up to 30 feet and attack, provided it does not move beyond the power’s range. To attack with it, make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 force damage. If it moves out of range, it fades away and the power ends.

You can spend psi points up to your per-use limit to issue multiple commands. Commands require no action, but you cannot exceed your psi-point limit in total commands issued, and each command can be issued only once per turn.

  • Grab (1 psi point): Usable only while the construct is Solidified. A creature within 5 feet of it that is no more than one size larger must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Restrained. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. The condition ends if the construct becomes ethereal or becomes more than one size smaller than the target.
  • Grow (1 psi point): The construct increases by one size and its number of damage dice increases by one. It returns to normal at the start of your next turn and can gain only one additional die.
  • Relocate (1 psi point): The construct disappears and reappears anywhere within 60 feet of you.
  • Replicate (3 psi points): Use Relocate, but the original does not disappear. Until the end of your turn, you have another construct and control both with the same action. Commands affect only one construct of your choice. Choose one to fade at the start of your next turn or use Sustain.
  • Solidify (1 psi point): The construct becomes solid, blocking its space until the start of your next turn. It must be in an unoccupied space. It has AC 16 and hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier plus your Psion level. It becomes ethereal again if reduced to 0 hit points.
  • Strike (2 psi points): The construct makes an attack, even if it has already attacked.
  • Sustain (1+ psi points): At the start of your turn, sustain a Solidify, Grow, or Replicate command for one additional round. Each effect can be sustained only once per turn; each sustained effect costs 1 psi point. Sustaining Solidify refreshes the construct’s hit points to its maximum.

abilities.name: Telekinesis Discipline
abilities.description:
Telekinesis is the ability to interact with physical objects and energy with your psionic powers.

Telekinetic Hands. You can manipulate small objects within 30 feet with your mind as if using your hand. You can manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour out the contents of a vial. You cannot Attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds this way. You can move a controlled item up to 30 feet during your turn. You can spend 1 or more psi points to increase the weight you can move by 100 pounds per point spent for 1 turn.

Alternate Effects. When you learn this discipline, you can use your Psionics feature to cast the following spells. If a spell can be cast at a higher level, you can spend additional psi points to cast it at a level equal to the psi points spent.

Point CostAlternate Effects

2fling, levitate, shatter
3fly, vortex blast
4orbital stones, resilient sphere
5telekinesis, wall of force, shockwave

options.name: Mental Might
options.description: You can use Intelligence instead of other ability modifiers when making an Athletics check. Additionally, you can attempt to grapple or shove a creature within 30 feet using your mind. You cannot move a creature grappled this way. Maintaining a grapple beyond your natural reach requires concentration, as if concentrating on a spell, and it ends if concentration is lost.

options.name: Precise Power
options.description: Animate objects is added to your Telekinesis Alternate Effects list and can be cast by expending 5 psi points. Additionally, when you see a ranged weapon attack being made against a target within 60 feet of you, you can use your reaction and expend 1 psi point to add or subtract 2d4 from that attack roll after it is rolled but before you know the outcome.

options.description: You can expend 1 psi point to gain 10 additional feet of movement and the effect of spider climb, feather fall, or levitate until the start of your next turn without an action. At the start of your next turn, you can expend 1 psi point to maintain the effect before it ends.

options.name: Telekinetic Weapons
options.description: You gain the Telekinetic Weapons psionic power as part of your Telekinetic Discipline, in addition to your other psionic powers.

The barrier is visible as small objects hover and float within it. A barrier around you moves with you. Ranged attacks passing through it have disadvantage. You can maintain the barrier by concentrating as if concentrating on a spell for up to 1 minute.

options.description: The fissure spell is added to your Telekinesis Alternate Effects list. Additionally, when a melee attack is made against you, you can use your reaction and expend 1 psi point to force the attacker to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is knocked 10 feet backward. If this puts the attack out of reach, the attack automatically misses.

abilities.name: Telepathy Discipline
abilities.description:
Telepathy is the ability to interact with the minds of other creatures using your psionic abilities.

Telepathic Communication. You can communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 30 feet. You need not share a language for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but it must understand at least one language. Creatures you communicate with can reply in kind.

Alternate Effects. When you learn this discipline, you can use your Psionics feature to cast the following spells. If a spell can be cast at a higher level, you can spend additional psi points to cast it at a level equal to the psi points spent.

options.name: Empathy
options.description: When a creature you can see within 120 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to grant it resistance to that damage, but you take psychic damage equal to the damage it takes after resistance. This damage cannot be reduced or prevented. If the damage would inflict a further negative status effect on the target, you can choose for that effect to affect you instead. If you have a telepathic bond allowing long-distance communication with the creature, the range is unlimited and you do not need to see it.

Its animation fades at the end of your next turn unless you expend a psionic charge or psi point on your next turn without an action to continue it for another round. You can spend Psionic Mastery points on this.

abilities.name: General Psionic Talents
abilities.description: General psionic talents available to any Psion, independent of known disciplines. Class-level talents such as Astral Arms, Aura Sight, and Schism live here.

modifier_catalog.name: Astral Arms
modifier_catalog.description: As a bonus action, you can expend 1 psi point to create psionic constructions that serve as additional appendages for 10 minutes. They vanish early if you are incapacitated or die. You can use them for unarmed strikes, using Intelligence instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls. On a hit, an astral-arm strike deals 1d6 plus your Intelligence modifier force damage instead of normal unarmed-strike bludgeoning damage. When you create the arms, or by spending 1 psi point as a bonus action while they are manifested, you can make one astral-arm unarmed strike as a bonus action. You can spend Psionic Mastery points on this.

modifier_catalog.name: Aura Sight
modifier_catalog.description: As an action, you can spend 1 psi point to see the aura of a creature within 30 feet. You learn whether spells or magical effects affect it and their schools of magic, if any, and whether it is under the influence of psionics. A shapeshifter or creature transformed or disguised by magical or nonmagical means makes a Charisma (Deception) check against your Psionics save DC. On a failure, you perceive its original form in its aura.

modifier_catalog.name: Awaken Mind
modifier_catalog.description: You can cast awaken once without expending a spell slot or psi points. Once you do, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

modifier_catalog.name: Beam of Annihilation
modifier_catalog.description: You can cast beam of annihilation by expending 6 psi points. If you have a Psychokinesis specialization, you can select only its related elemental damage type, but the beam’s damage ignores resistance to that damage type.

modifier_catalog.name: Controlled Power
modifier_catalog.description: You can suppress the glow and somatic component of your psionic powers. You can expend 2 psi points to use a power without a visual sign or somatic component. Each time you use this talent, its cost doubles until you finish a short or long rest.

modifier_catalog.name: Divided Mind
modifier_catalog.description: You learn divide self and can cast it by expending 5 psi points. Once you gain Innate Psionics, you can expend a use of Innate Psionics to cast divide self at the level of the expended use instead. You need not provide the spell’s material components when casting it with psi points or Innate Psionics.

modifier_catalog.name: Dreamwalker
modifier_catalog.description: You can cast dream without expending a spell slot. Once cast this way, you cannot cast it again until you finish a long rest.

modifier_catalog.name: Elemental Penetration
modifier_catalog.description: When you use a psionic power or spell that deals cold, fire, or lightning damage, you can expend 1 psi point to ignore resistance to that damage type. If you have a Psychokinesis specialization and the target is immune to the chosen type, the immunity becomes resistance for that power. You can spend Psionic Mastery points on this ability.

modifier_catalog.name: Empowered Strike
modifier_catalog.description: Once per turn, as part of making a weapon attack as part of the Attack action, you can empower a melee weapon with psionic power. On a hit, you can apply modifiers from Elemental Blast or Telekinetic Force, choosing only a power you know. This does not deal the power’s base damage, but added damage causes the power’s additional effects. If a modifier targets an area, only the weapon’s target takes weapon damage, but other creatures in the area become targets of the power normally. You can use Psionic Mastery on this.

modifier_catalog.name: Life Wielder
modifier_catalog.description: You learn invest life. You can spend Psionic Mastery points to cast this spell.

modifier_catalog.name: Mind Devourer
modifier_catalog.description: You can cast psychic drain by expending 2 psi points. Additionally, whenever a creature with Intelligence 6 or higher dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to draw in its psionic power, regaining 1d4 hit points and 1 expended psi point.

modifier_catalog.name: Mind Rider
modifier_catalog.description:
As an action, you can touch a willing creature to see through its eyes and hear what it hears for 1 hour, gaining the benefits of its special senses. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses. You can end the effect at any time. While it lasts, the creature has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

Using this action turns on Mind Rider on the sheet while you see through the target (you are deaf and blind to your own senses). Ally Int/Wis/Cha save advantage stays play-time — turn the toggle off when the link ends.

modifier_catalog.name: Perfect Focus
modifier_catalog.description: You can enter a state of extreme focus. Your concentration is not interrupted by using a second ability requiring concentration, but your speed is 0 while concentrating on more than one effect, and you have a −5 penalty to Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration. If you move or fail such a saving throw, one of your concentrated spells ends. If you fail by 5 or more, both end.

modifier_catalog.name: Personal Truth
modifier_catalog.description: If you spend at least 1 minute convincing yourself of something, even something absurd, spells and effects that determine whether you are telling the truth register that you believe what you convinced yourself of. When you expend 1 psi point, you can perform a minor alteration to reality: conjure any Tiny object worth 1 sp or less that you can imagine, though it does not grant knowledge you lack; change the color or taste of a Small or smaller object within 10 feet for 1 minute as an action; or use your reaction when a creature within 30 feet, including yourself, takes damage to change that damage’s type.

modifier_catalog.name: Potent Psionics
modifier_catalog.description: When a target succeeds on a saving throw against a damaging Psionic Power granted by a psionic discipline, it still takes half damage but suffers no other effects.

modifier_catalog.name: Psi Crystal
modifier_catalog.description:
You can expend 2 psi points to cast find familiar, but your familiar uses the Psi Crystal statistics and requires a crystal worth 10 gp instead of the spell’s normal material components. The Psi Crystal has your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You can use psionic disciplines with a range greater than Self through it as if standing in its location. If it is destroyed, you gain its memories as your own. While it is active, you can deactivate it as a bonus action to regain 2 expended psi points.

modifier_catalog.description: While you are not wearing armor or carrying a shield, your AC equals 13 + your Intelligence modifier.

modifier_catalog.description: You gain an additional Boundless Imagination option for Astral Construct: Horrifying Nightmare. modifier_catalog.name: Propelled Bound
modifier_catalog.description: When you move on your turn, you can expend movement up to your speed in a single bounding leap propelled by telekinetic power or psychokinetic force.

modifier_catalog.description: You can spend 1 psi point to temporarily divide your mind until the end of your turn. modifier_catalog.description: When you roll initiative, you can immediately increase your Rampage Die by one step, such as from d4 to d6. Additionally, when you take damage while your Rampage Die is d6 or lower, it increases by one step.

abilities.description:
You empower the body of a target creature you can see with your psionics. The target gains 1d6 temporary hit points, and the next time it deals damage, it deals 1d6 additional damage to one target of that damage roll. Any remaining temporary hit points from this power fade when you use it again.

  • Fortifying (1+ psi points): The target gains an extra 1d6 temporary hit points for each point spent.
  • Resilient (3 psi points): The target gains resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
  • Savage (1+ psi points): The target’s next weapon attack deals 1d6 additional damage for each point spent.
  • Swift (2 psi points): The target gains an additional action usable only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

abilities.name: Astral Construct
abilities.description:
You project an ethereal creation from your mind at a space you can see within range, taking the shape of a Medium or smaller creature, weapon, or other object. It is clearly ethereal. When you create it, and on subsequent turns when you use your action to mentally control it, you can move it up to 30 feet and attack, provided it does not move beyond the power’s range. To attack with it, make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 force damage. If it moves out of range, it fades away and the power ends.

You can spend psi points up to your per-use limit to issue multiple commands. Commands require no action, but you cannot exceed your psi-point limit in total commands issued, and each command can be issued only once per turn.

  • Grab (1 psi point): Usable only while the construct is Solidified. A creature within 5 feet of it that is no more than one size larger must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Restrained. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. The condition ends if the construct becomes ethereal or becomes more than one size smaller than the target.
  • Grow (1 psi point): The construct increases by one size and its number of damage dice increases by one. It returns to normal at the start of your next turn and can gain only one additional die.
  • Relocate (1 psi point): The construct disappears and reappears anywhere within 60 feet of you.
  • Replicate (3 psi points): Use Relocate, but the original does not disappear. Until the end of your turn, you have another construct and control both with the same action. Commands affect only one construct of your choice. Choose one to fade at the start of your next turn or use Sustain.
  • Solidify (1 psi point): The construct becomes solid, blocking its space until the start of your next turn. It must be in an unoccupied space. It has AC 16 and hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier plus your Psion level. It becomes ethereal again if reduced to 0 hit points.
  • Strike (2 psi points): The construct makes an attack, even if it has already attacked.
  • Sustain (1+ psi points): At the start of your turn, sustain a Solidify, Grow, or Replicate command for one additional round. Each effect can be sustained only once per turn; each sustained effect costs 1 psi point. Sustaining Solidify refreshes the construct’s hit points to its maximum.

abilities.name: Mind Leech
abilities.description:
A target you can see within range must make a Charisma saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage. If it is Frightened, Charmed, Stunned, Restrained, Grappled, or Paralyzed, it instead takes 1d12 psychic damage. On a failed save, you gain a psionic charge of consumed power until the end of your next turn. You can expend a charge when you deal damage to deal additional damage equal to your Intelligence modifier, or consume it at the end of your turn to gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier. You can spend only one charge at a time. You can also target a corpse that died within the last minute and has not previously been leeched with this power.

You can spend psi points up to your per-use limit to add multiple modifiers to Mind Leech.

  • Devouring (2 psi points): The range becomes a 5-foot-radius area centered on you.
  • Nourishing (1 psi point): On a failed save, you gain one additional psionic charge.
  • Rending (1+ psi points): On a failed save, the target takes one additional damage die per point spent.
  • Shredding (1 psi point): On a failed save, the target subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn.
  • Stunning (3 psi points): On a failed save, the target is Stunned until the start of your next turn. If multiple targets are affected, choose one target for this effect.
  • Thieving (1 psi point): On a failed save, you can take a 5th-level-or-lower spell the target can cast, if you know it can cast that spell. The target retains the spell, while you can cast it through Psionics by spending psi points equal to the spell’s level, subject to your psi-point limit and without Psionic Mastery. You can know one stolen spell at a time for 1 minute or until cast. If it restores hit points, you reduce your hit points by the amount healed.
